newsitem.title: UK: Daily Mail details Australian radio buy.
newsitem.headline: Daily Mail details Australian radio buy.

text.p: Daily Mail and General Trust Plc said on Tuesday that its subsidiary DMG Radio Australia had bought 85 percent of Broadcast Media Group (BMG), which owns 12 radio stations in New South Wales, Victoria and South Australia, for A$46 million (23.4 million stg) in cash.
